description: This file contains functions related to MAC address retrieval, manipulation, and device tree interactions, specifically for embedded Linux systems like OpenWrt. It includes methods for reading MAC addresses from various sources such as device tree, MTD partitions, and JSON configs, as well as functions for MAC address generation and modification.

methods.name: get_mac_label
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address label from device tree or JSON configuration.

methods.name: get_mac_binary
methods.description: Reads MAC address in binary form from a specified device or partition.

methods.name: get_mac_ascii
methods.description: Extracts MAC address in ASCII format from a partition or device.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_ascii
methods.description: Gets MAC address in ASCII from an MTD partition.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_encrypted_arcadyan
methods.description: Retrieves encrypted MAC address from an Arcadyan device partition.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_encrypted_deco
methods.description: Retrieves encrypted MAC address from a Deco device partition.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_uci_config_ubi
methods.description: Gets MAC address from UCI config in UBI volume.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_text
methods.description: Reads MAC address in text form from a specified MTD partition.

methods.name: macaddr_add
methods.description: Adds a value to a MAC address, modifying its NIC part.

methods.name: macaddr_generate_from_mmc_cid
methods.description: Generates a MAC address based on MMC device CID hash.

methods.name: macaddr_geteui
methods.description: Formats MAC address as EUI string with separator.

methods.name: macaddr_setbit
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in the MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_unsetbit
methods.description: Unsets a specific bit in the MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_setbit_la
methods.description: Sets the 'local administered' bit in the MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_unsetbit_mc
methods.description: Unsets the 'multicast' bit in the MAC address.

methods.name: dt_is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a device tree node is enabled.
